title: llm-kit call record, version 1
description: One sent try of a model call: tokens, cost and time, never prompt or reply text (@katsoft/llm-kit-send CallRecord). A consumer that stores records keeps this shape and may add its own fields beside it in its own store. Written in llm-scripting-kit.json-schema-subset/v1. Contract and shared cases: docs/reference/llm-kit-formats.md.

model.description: The model the provider reported, else the body's model.

provider.description: The host that served the try, when the provider named it.

ok.description: True when the try gave a parsed 2xx answer.

status.description: The HTTP status, or null with no response.

aborted.description: True when the caller's signal or the deadline cut the try after it was sent.

cost.description: The cost the host reported, in US dollars.

providerMessage.description: The provider's error message, at most 200 characters.
